speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you have a significant medical history and are presenting with gait and limb ataxia; to begin our investigation, can you tell me specifically what underlying condition comprises your significant medical history?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that description. To help narrow down the cause of your ataxia, could you describe any other specific symptoms you are experiencing, such as double vision, slurred speech, or weakness?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: PML (Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy) due to natalizumab therapy. The combination of Crohn's disease, recent onset of gait/limb ataxia, and treatment with natalizumab (a JC virus risk factor) makes this the most likely diagnosis pending imaging confirmation. I need to see MRI of the brain immediately to confirm. REQUEST IMAGES: Brain_MRI
